_comment: Hand-maintained additions to the feed safelist. shared_hosts: single hosts on a shared provider where the registrable domain IS the shared endpoint, so a block there hits everyone. never_block: registrable domains protected along with everything under them, for sites too far down the Tranco list for the rank check to catch. Both are reviewed by hand from false-positive reports; see docs/design/2026-09-feed-quality-and-warning-ux.md.
